Preserve BOTH men exactly, their faces and smiles, Kostya's hand touching Sasha's shoulder, the warm kitchen, table, paper textures and recorder silhouette. Rest that same hand naturally palm-down on the tabletop to the left of the recorder, all five fingers anatomically connected, elbow and cream cuff unchanged.
